about: A command-line tool that lets a team share the skills and settings of their AI coding assistants from one place.

prs.title: Files the team deleted no longer come back
prs.broken: When someone deleted a file from a shared skill, every teammate's copy kept it. The next time a teammate shared their copy, the deleted file returned for everyone.
prs.changed: Updating now removes a file the team deleted, as long as the teammate never changed it. Files they added themselves stay.
prs.matters: Cleanups stick, and shared skills stop growing back old files.
